items.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
items.overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

items.title: The Angel Maker
items.overview: Tells the story of the Swiss religious community of Methernitha, which still exists today, its founder Paul Baumann – the inventor of a mysterious energy machine – and the young women who brought him down on charges of child abuse.

items.title: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
items.overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. ATINY has vanished… As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY. Experience an intense immersion where every second counts with INCEPTION, an explosion of freedom and energy in the global hit BOUNCY (K-HOT CHILLI PEPPERS), and the pinnacle of refined charisma with Ice On My Teeth, now reimagined for the big screen. The world-class cinematic VR concert that captivated audiences around the globe has been fully refitted for cinemas, bringing ATEEZ's electrifying performances to life on the largest stage of all.

items.title: Csak egy éjszaka
items.overview:
Az egyetlen éjszakán, amikor a házasság előtti szex megengedett, két idegen kétségbeesetten keres partnert egy egyént korlátozó társadalomban.
 (Csillag Lajos)

items.title: Super Troopers 3
items.overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

items.title: Nimrods
items.overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

items.title: The Last House
items.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

items.title: I Is Another
items.overview: In 1952, a train journey to Oslo becomes a battleground when a journalist and her husband confront a man who claims to have saved thousands during WWII. As questions arise about his true motives, the line between hero and opportunist blurs.

items.title: For Sale By Exorcist
items.overview: Susan Price is a savvy realtor and certified exorcist who’s spent years flipping haunted houses across the country. From bleeding walls to glowing eyes, every listing is to die for! But as Susan hunts for her own forever home, the ghosts she’s evicted return for revenge. Will Susan settle with these vengeful spirits…or could she lose her life along with her down payment?

items.title: Olmo
items.overview: 1979, Új-Mexikó, USA. Olmo csapdába került. Ma neki kell ápolnia beteg édesapját, pedig még csak 14 éves, és sokkal inkább töltené az idejét legjobb barátjával, Miguellel. Amikor azonban Olmo meghívást kap gyönyörű szomszédjától, Ninától egy buliba, mindent megtesz, hogy kibújjon a kötelességei alól, és elindul egy csínyekkel teli, kaotikus estére. Ahogy az éjszaka telik, rádöbben, hogy talán megszereti azt a helyet, ahonnan eddig mindenáron el akart menekülni: az otthonát.

items.title: Az Oak Street vége
items.overview: A nyolcvanas évek vibráló világában egy család rejtélyes események hálójába keveredik, amelyek végigsöpörnek a környékükön, megkérdőjelezve a valóságról alkotott képüket, és izgalmas válaszkeresést indítanak el.  (Csillag Lajos)

items.title: Batwara 1947
items.overview: The story of an elderly Muslim woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Hindu refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

items.title: Robound
items.overview: The Perfect Partner Does Exist... From Sneaky Good Production & Verloren Productions comes - ROBOUND.

items.title: 4 Kids Walk Into a Bank
items.overview: After losing her mother, Paige's grandfather steps into to become a more responsible guardian. But when a group of criminals show up at their door demanding that Paige's grandpa join them for one last job, she's faced with a decision: let her newly reformed grandpa dip back into his criminal ways, or enlist her three best friends to do the job first.

items.title: DC
items.overview: Rebel Devadas joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stake in their fight.

items.title: The Last House
items.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

items.title: Grateful Dead Meet-Up at the Movies 2026
items.overview: Follows the complete June 17, 1991 Grateful Dead concert from Giants Stadium, featuring multi-camera visuals and surround sound, celebrating the 35th anniversary of this iconic show.

items.title: Hearing
items.overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships.

items.title: Sacrifice
items.overview: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

items.title: Union County
items.overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.
